description: Liquidation calculator. mode=perp: isolated-margin long/short liquidation and bankruptcy price from entry price, leverage and maintenance margin rate (optionally size and fees), with distance to liquidation. mode=lending: health factor, liquidation price of the collateral and safe borrow headroom for Aave/Compound/Kamino/Morpho-style loans from collateral, debt and liquidation threshold. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/liquidation-price

currentPrice.description: Optional current price for distance and status (default entryPrice / collateralPrice)

debt.description: lending: debt value in the same quote currency

feePct.description: perp: optional closing fee in percent of notional, reserved from margin

maintenanceMarginPct.description: perp: maintenance margin rate in percent

size.description: perp: optional position size in base units (for margin and notional)

name: liquidation_price
title: Liquidation Price
